# iotkit

> A no_std Rust firmware kit for ESP32 smart devices (esp-hal 1.2, Embassy): Wi-Fi setup, signed OTA updates with automatic rollback, Home Assistant over MQTT, Matter over Wi-Fi and Thread, deep sleep. A device's main lists its entities and calls `iotkit::start`. Not released yet; depend on the git repository.

Crates: `iotkit` (what a device depends on; chip feature such as `esp32c6`), `iotkit-core` (chip-independent, re-exported by `iotkit`). CLI: `cargo iotkit` (`new`, `build`, `flash`, `ota push`, `ota publish`, `web`). API docs: `cargo doc -p iotkit --open` in a project.

## Guide

- [Introduction](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/introduction.html): what iotkit does, iotkit and ESPHome, status, chips
- [Getting started](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/getting-started.html): tools, `cargo iotkit new`, first flash, Wi-Fi setup
- [Coming from ESPHome](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/coming-from-esphome.html): each YAML block and its iotkit code
- [Install from the browser](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/install-from-browser.html): ESP Web Tools page from `cargo iotkit build`
- [Entities and settings](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/entities.html): entity kinds, DeviceClass, Unit, Config, Setting
- [Components and drivers](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/components.html): relay, binary_input, button, dimmer, fan, rgb_light, poll, filters, any embedded-hal driver
- [Home Assistant and Matter](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/home-assistant.html): MQTT discovery, topics, Matter device types
- [Updates](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/updates.html): signed OTA, rollback, updates from Home Assistant, keys
- [Battery devices](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/battery.html): deep sleep with `start_sleepy`
- [Only what the device uses](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/lean.html): opt-out features, IOTKIT_HOSTNAME, IOTKIT_TOPIC_PREFIX
- [Console, logs, editor](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/console.html): USB console commands, ESP_LOG
- [Troubleshooting](https://tanguy-c.github.io/iotkit/troubleshooting.html)

## Code

- [Examples](https://github.com/tanguy-c/iotkit/tree/main/apps): devkit, showcase, sleepy, lean, thread-light
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/tanguy-c/iotkit/blob/main/AGENTS.md): working on iotkit itself
